rows.text: You sit on the hot sofa as the lights make you temporarily dizzy. The game of bravery: Pineapple Bread is approaching its final stages as everyone awaits your decision as the final survivor.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "There are two boxes left. Eat the pineapple and take the prize or eat the bread and get lost." The manic faces of the audience are reflected in the host's compound eyes — They don't want to see you win. They want to see you fail.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: There are over nine thousand objects in the cosmos that go by the name of "pineapple." Some are rocks, some are leaves, and some are even black holes. Until you open this box, no one knows what lies within.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your brain freezes as images of the last runner-up being evaporated by a plasma pineapple rush through your mind.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Pineapple or bread!?" The spectators impatiently spur you on.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: One doesn't get rich without taking risks! As you swallow the pineapple, a bitterness runs over your tongue.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You become deeply aware of a great truth: That no matter how much money you have, you have to be alive to spend it.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Take a drink and calm down.
This program is sponsored by the Interastral Peace Corporation. Authentic pineapple soda, bringing you an unforgettable feast of flavor.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
